maturity.name: Pen plotters
maturity.call: The house physical format: a platform (Plottables), a standard workflow, and still gaining share.
maturity.earliest: 1965 Georg Nees [sourced]; crypto 2022 Plottables [sourced]; AB data 2021-06-03 Fidenza
maturity.barrier: Plot time per unique output; one plot per token tracked off-chain [sourced/estimate]
maturity.momentum: Rising
maturity.learnMore: AxiDraw docs (Evil Mad Scientist) <https://wiki.evilmadscientist.com/AxiDraw> | AxiDraw Python API <https://axidraw.com/doc/py_api/> | vpype <https://vpype.readthedocs.io/en/latest/>

maturity.name: Inkjet / giclée / archival prints
maturity.disagree: AB share is falling, but the tag is mostly description guesses and prints are a commodity off the page; keep SRB's Mature.
maturity.call: Default companion product; commodity now, so the edge is authentication, not paper.
maturity.earliest: 2021 token-gated prints [sourced]; AB data 2020-11-27 Chromie Squiggle (prints claim 2022)
maturity.barrier: Proving ownership at order time; easy to counterfeit without a chip [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Screen print / silkscreen
maturity.disagree: SRB says Emergent; we call Under-explored: only 2 verified works, no AB use after 2024, and SRB's own barrier says it doesn't fit unique long-form.
maturity.call: Prestige one-offs, not a long-form format: screens are per image.
maturity.abTrend: 9 (2 verified, 7 guessed) · no AB use after 2024 ⚠
maturity.barrier: Screens set up per image: suits editions of one output, not 1,000 unique outputs [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Risograph
maturity.call: Cheapest unique-per-sheet print, and almost nobody has done it. Whitespace.
maturity.barrier: Limited inks, small sheets, low archival status [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Darkroom / film / cyanotype
maturity.call: Beautiful and slow; a craft niche that rewards the few who do it.
maturity.barrier: Darkroom skill, chemicals, slow unique output [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Embroidery
maturity.call: Real momentum: {LOGO} made embroidery export a token feature.
maturity.barrier: Thread palettes, digitizing density, garment sizes [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Rising

maturity.name: Weaving / Jacquard / tapestry / cane
maturity.call: Prestige output (Aubusson, Drucker); cost keeps it to flagship drops.
maturity.abTrend: 59 textiles tag (10 verified, 49 guessed) · rising ⚠ guess-heavy
maturity.barrier: Cost, loom palette, non-square pixels [sourced]; redemption deadlines [sourced]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Machine knitting
maturity.call: A few serious practitioners; machine access is the gate.
maturity.barrier: Machine availability; yarn and tension variability [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend
maturity.learnMore: AYAB (open-source knitting control) <https://www.ayab-knitting.com/> | Wikipedia: Knitting machine <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Knitting_machine>

maturity.name: Generative fashion / apparel
maturity.call: Works as merch; unique-per-token clashes with batch manufacturing.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Laser cutting
maturity.call: Cheap and SVG-native, yet absent from Art Blocks descriptions.
maturity.barrier: Hand assembly time; fire and material safety [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: CNC milling / engraving
maturity.call: One-offs; per-output toolpaths are the cost.
maturity.barrier: Machine cost; toolpath effort per unique output [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: 3D printing: FDM / resin
maturity.call: Exports exist (.obj); collectors lack printers, so finishing is the product.
maturity.abTrend: related: token as fabrication file, 7 verified
maturity.earliest: 2022 Aranda Lasch, Primitives (.obj) [sourced]; AB data 2022-11-10 fabrication-file token
maturity.barrier: Printability; collectors don't own printers; low value unless finished [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: 3D printing: ceramic clay
maturity.call: Nothing token-linked found; exports already exist. Whitespace.
maturity.barrier: Clay printers, kiln firing, shrinkage and cracking [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: 3D printing: metal / bronze casting
maturity.call: Foundry costs make it a 1/1 move, not an edition.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Ceramics (hand / kiln)
maturity.call: Pairs well with AI/GAN work; breakage and shipping keep it rare.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Glass / stained glass
maturity.call: One flagship example; craft labor is the barrier.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Sculpture / lighting objects
maturity.disagree: AB share looks falling, but that comes from guessed 'sculpture' metaphors; the verified works are 2024, so keep SRB's Emergent.
maturity.call: Verified core is recent (2024 lamps and sculptures); small editions only.
maturity.barrier: Small edition needed to stay economical [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Kinetic sculpture
maturity.call: Talked about, not built: no kinetic token-linked object found.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend
maturity.learnMore: Adafruit Arduino lesson 14: servo motors <https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-arduino-lesson-14-servo-motors> | Wikipedia: Kinetic art <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinetic_art>

maturity.name: Furniture / architecture
maturity.call: Enlace proved tokens can redeem furniture; logistics keep it rare.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Food
maturity.call: Nothing token-linked; perishability fights permanence.
maturity.barrier: Perishability, food safety, no lasting object [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Scent / perfume
maturity.call: One serious example (INK); hard to make deterministic.
maturity.barrier: Needs a perfumer; subjective mapping; shipping limits [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Vinyl / physical music releases
maturity.call: Unique jackets work; pressing minimums don't.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Projectors / projection mapping
maturity.disagree: SRB says Emergent; we call Under-explored for this map's scope: zero Art Blocks descriptions mention projection and SRB itself says it is rare for collector-owned long-form.
maturity.call: Mature for installations, absent from collector-owned long-form.
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: LED walls / pixel screens
maturity.call: Rented spectacle (Times Square), not owned display.
maturity.barrier: Cost; rental rather than owned display [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend

maturity.name: Dynamic NFT displays (Infinite Objects, Tokenframe)
maturity.disagree: SRB splits it: Mature for video, Emergent for live code. We map the primary call, Mature.
maturity.call: Mature for looped video; live code on a frame is still unsolved.
maturity.barrier: Live code needs a GPU and browser; looped video freezes a live work [estimate]
maturity.momentum: Unclear / too few / no AB trend
maturity.learnMore: Art Blocks: token and generator APIs <https://docs.artblocks.io/developer/token-and-generator-apis/> | Infinite Objects <https://infiniteobjects.com/>

maturity.name: E-ink / e-paper

whitespace.pick: Chip-verified physical outputs with on-chain redemption state
whitespace.why: Plotters are rising (46 projects), post-mint params are new (2025), and physical redemption went quiet after Feb 2024: the link between token and object is the weakest point.
whitespace.test: Chip 10 pen plots with NTAG424 tags; write a testnet post-mint flag 'physical: issued / chip UID'; the live view shows 'plotted'. [SRB]
whitespace.data: Plotter 46 rising; physical redemption 6, none after 2024; PMP 3 (2025)

whitespace.why: 191 projects already read the clock and the share is rising, so a large catalogue fits a low-power frame; e-ink has no artist-native edition yet.
whitespace.test: Waveshare 7.3-inch colour e-ink + ESP32 (≈$100 [estimate]) running a p5 sketch that renders hourly; show it at an Art Blocks event. [SRB]

whitespace.why: LIFT (ROM in token, 2025) and mio (2026, off Art Blocks) show live momentum around this exact studio; the risk is that each build is bespoke.
whitespace.test: Flash LIFT-style ROMs onto 10 reproduction GBA carts, or an ESP32 + small OLED kit, as a redemption for one Factory project. [SRB]
whitespace.data: ROM in token 1 (2025); custom hardware 0 on-chain

whitespace.pick: Risograph and darkroom editions as the affordable physical tier
whitespace.why: Prints and screen prints are fading on Art Blocks while risograph has 2 guessed projects: the cheapest unique-per-sheet format is nearly empty.
whitespace.test: 50-sheet riso run of 50 different outputs from one project; measure cost per sheet and collector uptake. [SRB]

whitespace.why: Unused on Art Blocks, but webcam/mic input faded after 2024, so permission-gated inputs have a poor track record; a separate sensor box sidesteps that.
whitespace.test: $20–40 PM2.5/CO₂ sensor [estimate] on an ESP32 feeding a WebSocket into an existing p5 token. [SRB]

whitespace.why: Nothing token-linked found; 7 tokens already act as fabrication files, so the export side is solved.
whitespace.test: Send 3 STL exports from an .obj-capable token to a ceramic-printing studio; compare cost and failure rate. [SRB]

whitespace.why: Totem shows heartbeat data works; capture-once avoids long-term health data.
whitespace.test: Web mint page that reads heart rate from the phone camera (finger on lens) and seeds parameters; pilot at a live event. [SRB]

whitespace.pick: Spatial / WebXR wrappers for three.js tokens
whitespace.why: 84 three.js projects (flat) could gain XR, but A-Frame has had no AB use since 2021: demand is unproven.
whitespace.test: Generic WebXR viewer loading any Art Blocks three.js token in a Quest or Vision Pro browser; check 5 projects render. [SRB]

whitespace.why: INK is the only example; fun, but hard to make deterministic.
whitespace.test: A perfumer maps 3 parameters to accords; 6 samples; blind-match test with collectors. [SRB]

whitespace.pick: Robot-arm live performance as a minting event
whitespace.why: Proven in art, absent on Art Blocks, and the most expensive test here.
whitespace.test: Hobby arm (≈$300–2,000 [estimate]) or a university lab draws the token's SVG live; record the stream hash on-chain. [SRB]

whitespace.pick: Tokens as agents: a generative piece that is also an agent with its own wallet
whitespace.confidence: not an SRB pick (Shawn's idea, unranked)
whitespace.why: No Art Blocks use found. 721T (on ERC-8048) gives a token agent context and endpoints, ERC-6551 gives it a wallet, and Loopers (2026-09-18) shows the stack in use outside art. Unproven demand, so we keep it out of the ranking.
whitespace.test: Our test, not SRB's: on a testnet, give one generative token a 721T context key and web endpoint, plus an ERC-6551 account; check that a collector can find it and that it can hold one other token.
